scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving clothing & personal items
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Clothing and Personal Items
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: clothing & personal items — a misunderstanding or problem involving clothing & personal items
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving clothing & personal items; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Ms Emma this is not the style she wanted.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với chị Emma đây không phải kiểu dáng mình muốn.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Emma. This is not the style I wanted.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Emma. Đây không phải kiểu dáng tôi muốn.

turns.speaker: Ms Emma
turns.english: Oh, I see the mix-up. Let me find the right one.
turns.vietnamese: Ồ, tôi thấy nhầm lẫn rồi. Để tôi tìm đúng cái nhé.
